faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.upgradeQuestion: How do I upgrade my plan?
faq.upgradeAnswer: You can upgrade your plan at any time from this pricing page. The new plan will be effective immediately.
faq.cancelAnswer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You will continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
faq.downgradeAnswer: If you downgrade, you'll keep your current plan until the end of the billing period, then switch to the new plan.
